title: BOS-1151 One organization fails and the list still renders

env.BOSS_ORG_E2E_SESSION_READ_FAILURE: Globex Industries:sessions for this organization could not be read right now

scenes.title: a failed organization is named, and the sessions that were read still render

steps.caption: The board has settled on the home session list

expect.label: the board says the list is short rather than silently showing fewer rows
the failing organization is named, so the user knows WHAT is missing

expect.text: sessions for this organization could not be read right now
expect.label: the server's reason is passed through verbatim, not re-worded into this view's guess
a session that WAS read is still listed

expect.text: Add rate limiting to public API
expect.label: and so is the other readable organization's second session — the list is degraded, not emptied
the failed organization's sessions really are absent, so the notice is describing a genuine partial read

steps.caption: A cross-organization read is a fan-out, so one organization failing yields a short list rather than an error. Without the notice the missing rows read as 'that organization has no sessions' — the wrong conclusion, in the one view whose job is seeing across organizations.
